name: Elimentary
long_description:
Elimentary’s is building AI agents that can run middle/back-office operations for private capital managers, starting with structured credit. Most private capital managers focus primarily on sourcing and capital deployment. Meanwhile post-investment operations receive step-child treatment. While AUMs have increased exponentially over the last decade, operations continue to be painfully supported by humans using spreadsheets and emails. Things have started to break leading to investment write-offs, fines, penalties, and sometimes lost LP relationships. 

Our agents can run these operations (borrowing base calcs, cracking loan tapes, NAV calculations, etc.) end to end autonomously. For one of our customers, our agents cut a 20-hour ops process to 30 minutes. It saved 90% of the manual hours, translating to $150k in annual savings.
one_liner: Agents that run middle/back-office operations for Private Capital

launches.title: Elimentary: Your AI operations team for private credit
launches.tagline: AI agents that run middle and back office for private credit funds
launches.body:
**TL;DR:** Elimentary builds AI agents that run the monthly operations of private credit funds. Agents process loan data, monitor covenants, reconcile accounts and automate reporting for LPs, Fund Admins, Custodians and every stakeholder involved. 

**The Problem:**

The Private Credit industry has grown exponentially to \~$2 Trillion. But the underlying operations in this industry are still run manually on spreadsheets. Every month, a private credit fund receives loan files, bank statements and reports from borrowers, servicers and fund administrators. Their Analysts have to check the deal's terms, spot covenant breaches, reconcile the numbers and prepare reports for regulators, investors and LPs.

The current process is prone to human lapses and oversight leading to AUM write-offs (ex: First Brands - $11.5 Billion) and even worse - penalties and fines by the regulator.

**Our Solution?**

Elimentary brings that work into a coordinated team of agents:

* **Process loan data:** turn inconsistent loan files into structured tables.
* **Monitor covenants:** parse agreement and check the conditions borrowers must meet.
* **Reconcile accounts:** compare balances and transactions across financial records.
* **Prepare reporting:** assemble the outputs for fund and investor reports.

Take a recurring fund reconciliation. The agents compare bank records with the fund administrator's records and prepare the reconciliation for the Finance team to review. People retain the final sign-off. This enables the fund to keep scaling without scaling headcount.

TresVista (\~2,000 analysts) signed a multi-year contract to bring our agents into fund reporting and CFO-office work. ([TresVista PR link](https://www.tresvista.com/tresvista-partners-with-elimentary-to-bring-ai-agents-into-fund-reporting-and-cfo-office-operations-for-private-capital-managers/))

**See Elimentary in action**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g20go4g8-ds&feature=youtu.be>

**The Team**

We have deep domain experience spanning credit, capital markets, fintech and AI. Yogesh previously worked at UBS, Goldman Sachs and Flipkart. Mannat has led engineering teams at Goldman Sachs, Jefferies and Flipkart. Manoj co-founded Skit Ai (voice ai for debt collection). Collectively, we’ve built and scaled products used by global top-tier banks, credit institutions and large fintechs.

**Our Ask**

Know a COO, CFO or Head of Operations at any Private Credit Funds? Introduce us at [founders@elimentary.com](mailto:founders@elimentary.com).
